oracle_provenance: Standard textbook binomial acceptance-sampling OC-curve formula; independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded acceptance-sampling probability at a single declared defect rate; not a full producer/consumer risk study.

cases.question: At a low 1% true defect rate, does the n=50,c=1 sampling plan accept the lot with high probability?
At a higher 5% true defect rate, does the same plan's acceptance probability drop well below the 0.9 minimum, correctly discriminating bad lots?
Must an acceptance number greater than the sample size be rejected as structurally invalid?
At an assumed defect rate of exactly zero, does the model correctly predict certain acceptance (probability 1), its own trivial self-consistency check?
